Mizoram floods and landslides force evacuation of over 100 families

Heavy rainfall has caused the Khawthlangtuipui river to overflow in Mizoram, leading to severe flooding and landslides. Over 100 families have been evacuated from their homes as normal life has been disrupted. Officials have reported the situation, highlighting the impact of the natural disaster.
